card.name: Adverbs and links before a verb
card.fires_on: Small adverbs or linking words such as longer, now, immediately, carefully, easily, frequently, once, placed right before the main verb or clause continues. It is strongest after a subject or verb phrase where an adverb or verb is expected next.

modes.label: Time adverb before verb
modes.description: Words like longer, now, once that mark timing and come just before a verb such as requires or is.
modes.example: may be physically dependent no<< longer>> requires therapy with TUXARIN ER

modes.label: Manner adverb or linking word
modes.description: Adverbs like carefully, easily, or a comma or 'and' after an adverb, with a further clause coming next.
modes.example: patients with compensated cirrhosis frequently<< and>> discontinue LIVMARLI if hep

card.writes: It adds a push toward adverb-like or narrative words such as later, clearly and shrugged, though the other tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires on little adverbs and linking words that sit just before the main verb of a statement.
